# dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset }

```python
FmriDataset(
    data_source,
    event_table=None,
    censor=None,
    *,
    sampling_frame=None,
    confounds=None,
)
```

fMRI dataset combining time-series data with experimental events.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|----------------|----------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data_source    | StorageBackend or DatasetProtocol      | A storage backend (pass ``sampling_frame``), one of fmrimod's adapters, or any object satisfying `DatasetProtocol`.                                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| event_table    | pd.DataFrame                           | Table of experimental events with at least ``onset`` and ``block`` (or ``run``) columns.  Additional columns are event variables.                                                                                                                              | `None`     |
| censor         | NDArray\[np.bool_\] or list of NDArray | Boolean censoring vector(s).  ``True`` marks volumes to exclude. Can be a single array covering all runs concatenated, or a list of per-run arrays.                                                                                                            | `None`     |
| sampling_frame | SamplingFrame                          | Run structure of the rows. Required with a bare backend; otherwise it overrides the adapter's own frame.                                                                                                                                                       | `None`     |
| confounds      | list of pd.DataFrame                   | Per-run nuisance tables (e.g. fMRIPrep ``*_desc-confounds_timeseries``), one row per scan. Nothing is modelled from them by default; a ``confounds("trans_x", ...)`` spec term without ``source=`` selects columns from these tables when the model is fitted. | `None`     |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `blocklens` | Alias for per-run lengths during the consolidation migration. |
| `censor` | Per-run boolean censor vectors, or *None*. |
| `confounds` | Per-run nuisance tables attached to the dataset, or *None*. |
| `event_table` | The event table, or *None* if not set. |
| `n_timepoints` | Total number of timepoints across all runs. |
| `run_lengths` | Number of timepoints per run. |
| `sampling_frame` | Convenience alias for ``get_sampling_frame()``. |
| `space` | Spatial identity of the columns: grid, in-mask voxels, affine. |
| `storage_backend` | The storage backend every read goes through. |

```

### get_all_data { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.get_all_data }

```

Return all runs vertically concatenated as ``(total_time, voxels)``.

### get_censor { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.get_censor }

```python
get_censor(run)
```

Return the censor vector for a single run, or *None*.

### get_data { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.get_data }

```python
get_data(run=None, *, rows=None, cols=None)
```

Return data by matrix slice or, temporarily, by run.

``rows``/``cols`` select timepoints and in-mask voxels; the backend
reads only those. Positional run access is retained during the
migration; new code should use `get_run_data`.

### get_data_matrix { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.get_data_matrix }

```python
get_data_matrix(rows=None, cols=None)
```

Return all data as a ``timepoints x voxels`` matrix.

### with_event_table { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.with_event_table }

### with_scaling { #fmrimod.dataset.fmri_dataset.FmriDataset.with_scaling }

```python
with_scaling(scale)
```

Return this dataset with read-time signal scaling.

``scale="psc"`` reports every read as percent signal change of each
voxel's run mean, ``100 * (y / mean - 1)`` (Nilearn's
``signal_scaling=0``). ``None`` returns the dataset unchanged.
